newsitem.title: USA: FSI International gets $10 mln order.
newsitem.headline: FSI International gets $10 mln order.

text.p: FSI International Inc, which makes capital equipment for the microelectronics industry, said Tuesday it received a $10 million order to provide chemical management equipment and support to Anam Industrial Co Ltd.
The equipment will be for Anam's new semiconductor device manufacturing facility in Seoul, Korea.

The equipment will control blending and delivery of high purity chemicals and slurries within the Anam manufacturing facility. FSI will provide control and monitoring equipment, startup services and training.
Equipment shipment is expected early this year with installation to be completed in the second half of the year.
